messages:
Maya: FYI — saw tenant acme-corp hit their Dedicated pool and requests were routed to hosted. That introduced noisy KV-cache cold starts and some rate-limiting for other hosted customers.
Sandeep: Was this the default fallback rule? I thought dedicated tenants with commits shouldn't spill by default.
Maya: It went to hosted because Dedicated pool exhausted in region us-west-2 and policy allowed 'regional_fallback: true'.
Liam: We need to stop blanket spillover. Two options: per-tenant opt-in for hosted fallback OR route to a cheaper model_variant on Dedicated (quantized) before spilling.
Julie: Can we also emit a high-cardinality metric: spillover.count{tenant,region,model_variant,reason} so SRE/customer-success can alert? Right now we only log events.
Sandeep: +1. Also need an audit trail visible in Console: which requests spilled + user-visible flag to control per-tenant policy.
Arthur: For Dedicated customers who paid for isolation, spilling them is a contractual/SLAs issue. We should default to 'isolate' for commit > X and surface override only via Support/Contract.
Maya: Agreed. Implementation sketch:

```:
routing_policies:
  - tenant_selector: "tenant.commit_level >= 1"
    fallback: NONE
  - tenant_selector: "default"
    fallback: HOSTED
```

Maya: Note the second rule is our current global fallback. We need a migration plan.
Liam: Migration proposal: write a compatibility flag `allow_hosted_fallback` default false for Dedicated tenants with commits > 0. Rollout in 3 phases: telemetry -> console toggle -> enforce.
Julie: UX: add 'Fallback behavior' to tenant settings page with 3 options: Enforce isolation, Allow hosted fallback, Allow variant downgrade (cheaper variant on same pool).
Sandeep: Telemetry: spike in latency when spillover happens, also token cost increases. We should link spillover events to per-route token/cost dashboard.
platform-bot: deploy queued: infra/routing/2026-03-18 -> staging
Maya: Can someone draft the policy PR? I'll coordinate with legal/customer success for the default for committed customers.
Liam: I'll start a PR for the policy + metric schema.
Julie: I'll mock the Console change and send screenshots.
Arthur: ping @support-ops for any customer contracts mentioning 'no shared capacity'.
Maya: Thanks. Let's keep the thread for design notes and link to RFC when ready. :thumbsup:
